exposure: Introduction of a Normal Birth Guideline
cohort: Over 500,000 women with no medical conditions, low-risk pregnancy, gestations between 37 weeks to 41 weeks and 6 days, single fetus, cephalic presentation, live birth, and receiving public care in Queensland, Australia.
finding: The incidence of caesarean section tripled for women who were induced and also had an epidural compared to women who laboured spontaneously without epidural, while demographic features were not found to be major independent contributors to declining normal birth rates.
mod_finding: The incidence of caesarean section tripled for women who were induced and also had an epidural compared to women who laboured spontaneously without epidural.
